    // Precondition: every strata count is positive.
    StratifiedPoints3D(region: Bounds3D, strataCounts: IntegerVector3,
        samplesPerStratum: Integer, seed: Integer): Array<Point3D>

            StratumPoint3D(region, strataCounts, seed, n / samplesPerStratum, n % samplesPerStratum));
